name: samdesk-support
description: Read selected SamDesk support conversations, find customer agreements and draft a reply in your AI assistant. Uses your existing SamDesk account and current inbox permissions. Private notes, attachments and channel configuration are excluded. This plugin never sends messages or changes conversations.

interface.longDescription: Read selected SamDesk support conversations, find customer agreements and draft a reply in your AI assistant. publication.release_notes: Initial read-only release: scoped inboxes, conversation search, selected conversation context and customer conversation history.

positive.expected_behavior: Only the synthetic reviewer organization appears.
